name: Summit AZ - Context - Claude Settings and Worktrees
body:
> Tool · Summit Az · 2026-09-23

# Summary
Project-level Claude Code folder for Summit. No skills or agents are defined here; it holds a local permissions file and two old git worktrees.

# Contents
- `settings.local.json` (updated 2026-09-23): 22 allowed permissions. They cover reading the SSH config and keys folder, SSH connectivity checks to the `summit` and `pipeliners` host aliases, curl fetches of the Summit robots.txt, sitemaps and homepage, Claude in Chrome browser tools, `python -` and a PowerShell tail of `Summit-AZ-SEO-Change-Log.csv`. No secrets are stored in the file (key file names only).
- `worktrees\confident-snyder-6e39bc` (2026-05-20) and `worktrees\thirsty-moore-c36100` (2026-05-21): placeholder repo copies ("Project files will be added here") with a standard `.gitignore` that excludes `.env`, keys and credential files. Each has its own copy of the settings file (15 permissions).
- `PAGES.md` in the first worktree is summarized in [Summit AZ - Context - Page Coverage Snapshot 2026-05-20](lib:brain-summit-az-context-page-coverage-snapshot-2026-05-20).
